name: galaxz-ab-bars
description: The step row's playhead stays white on odd patterns (A) and is purple on even ones (B), so a chain of two patterns reads as 32 steps. See ab/ab_bars.S.

edits.what: the UI frame's call after the screens have drawn goes through the A/B bars first (which then jump on to it)
edits.evidence: [code] 'CALL 0x8003c6c8' at 0x8010a97a, its only caller, one argument in R0; 'CALL 0x80c20000' has the same size; notes/device-guide.md 10

revert: Flash Galax-z v2 (the hub, or Firmware/flash).
risk: Our code runs every UI frame, reading two sequencer fields and changing 16 LED records. If it fails, the OS fails right after start-up: switch off, update mode (SCREEN), flash Galax-z v2 or the original.

earlier.what: the A/B bars, first version (light blue / light purple), flashed 2026-11-21
